browser_executables.name: chromium
browser_executables.executable: browsers/chromium-1234/chrome-mac-arm64/Google Chrome for Testing.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome for Testing

catalog.title: Present the general DocForge workbench identity
catalog.goal: Prove the visible product identity and user-facing language describe a general Markdown-to-Word workbench.

steps.action: Run the current frontend component and application test suite.
steps.expected: The DocForge brand, general document language, Word template controls, and status copy pass their assertions.

assertions.statement: The visible workbench identity is DocForge and no longer presents the product as an academic-only workbench.

catalog.title: Preserve document command and preview behavior
catalog.goal: Prove open, edit, save, validate, template, build, cancel, output, and real HTTP preview flows retain their behavior.
preconditions: The frontend dependencies, Playwright browser, and Python environment are available.

steps.action: Run the complete browser matrix and real Python HTTP acceptance command.
steps.expected: All enabled browser scenarios and the real HTTP user flow pass while intentional matrix exclusions remain explicit.

assertions.statement: The current command, transport, cancellation, output, and preview flows pass without fallback behavior.

catalog.title: Verify the approved desktop workbench hierarchy
catalog.goal: Prove the recorded desktop production image is 1440x1024 and the direct design QA result is passed.
preconditions: The production desktop screenshot and design QA record are present.

steps.action: Inspect the PNG header dimensions and the direct design QA verdict.
steps.expected: The desktop artifact is exactly 1440x1024 and design-qa.md records a passed final result.

assertions.statement: The desktop visual evidence matches the approved viewport and hierarchy review.

args:
set -eu; python3 -c 'import struct; from pathlib import Path; image=Path("openspec/changes/docforge-workbench-ui-redesign/verification/desktop-1440x1024.png"); data=image.read_bytes(); assert data[:8] == b"\x89PNG
\x1a
"; assert struct.unpack(">II", data[16:24]) == (1440, 1024); assert "final result: passed" in Path("design-qa.md").read_text()'; printf '%s
' '{"assertion_id":"a3-desktop-hierarchy","method":"equal","expected":true,"actual":true,"status":"passed"}' >> "$SPECNAV_VERIFICATION_ASSERTION_RESULT_FILE"

catalog.title: Expose all mobile workbench panels without overflow
catalog.goal: Prove the 390x844 mobile artifact and focused mobile navigation scenarios expose every core panel without horizontal overflow.
preconditions: The mobile production screenshot, frontend server, and Playwright browser are available.

steps.action: Validate the mobile screenshot dimensions and run the focused mobile Playwright scenarios.
steps.expected: The artifact is exactly 390x844 and both mobile navigation and compact identity scenarios pass.

assertions.statement: Outline, editor, preview, and diagnostics remain accessible on mobile without horizontal overflow.

args:
set -eu; python3 -c 'import struct; from pathlib import Path; data=Path("openspec/changes/docforge-workbench-ui-redesign/verification/mobile-390x844.png").read_bytes(); assert data[:8] == b"\x89PNG
\x1a
"; assert struct.unpack(">II", data[16:24]) == (390, 844)'; pnpm --dir frontend exec playwright test e2e/workbench.spec.ts --project=mobile-chromium --grep 'uses mobile panel navigation|keeps the product identity'; printf '%s
' '{"assertion_id":"a4-mobile-panels","method":"equal","expected":true,"actual":true,"status":"passed"}' >> "$SPECNAV_VERIFICATION_ASSERTION_RESULT_FILE"

catalog.title: Preserve the document compilation architecture boundary
catalog.goal: Prove the UI implementation commit does not edit parser, domain, compiler, RenderPlan, or DOCX renderer modules and the frontend remains type- and lint-clean.
preconditions: The UI implementation commit and frontend toolchain are available.

steps.action: Inspect the UI implementation commit file list and run current typecheck and lint.
steps.expected: No document compilation module appears in the UI commit and current frontend static checks pass.

assertions.statement: The frontend redesign remains outside the parser-to-DOCX compilation layers.

args:
set -eu; files=$(git show --pretty='' --name-only ee29f27); if printf '%s
' "$files" | grep -Eq '^(src/docforge|src/thesis_forge)/'; then printf '%s
' "$files"; exit 1; fi; pnpm frontend:typecheck; pnpm frontend:lint; printf '%s
' '{"assertion_id":"a5-ui-boundary","method":"equal","expected":true,"actual":true,"status":"passed"}' >> "$SPECNAV_VERIFICATION_ASSERTION_RESULT_FILE"
